purpose: Stress-test the canonical material-grade model against large commercial engineering-plastics catalogues without publishing unverified grade claims.
notes: This umbrella manifest tracks pilot progress without duplicating exact-grade records; gradeRecords intentionally remains empty here.
LOTTE pilot progress points to the separately validated lotte-exact-grade-pilot-v1 dataset and the published runtime catalog.
LG Chem, KEP and KOLON ENP remain discovery targets until primary-source exact-grade records pass the same staging and semantic gates.
Acquired source documents should be fingerprinted before extraction where redistribution/rights permit local retention.
Every extracted observation must reference a sourceId and retain its test conditions rather than collapsing datasheet tables into generic values.
